title: Event Bus Pattern — Companion Files
description: Runnable in-memory Event Bus in three languages: thread-safe Python bus with unsubscribe closures, a Map-based JavaScript version, and a lock-free Java implementation with CopyOnWriteArrayList. Includes pytest and node:test suites covering fan-out, unsubscribe, failure isolation, and unsubscribe-during-dispatch.
description_es: Event Bus en memoria ejecutable en tres lenguajes: bus Python thread-safe con funciones de desuscripción, versión JavaScript basada en Map, e implementación Java sin locks con CopyOnWriteArrayList. Incluye suites pytest y node:test que cubren fan-out, desuscripción, aislamiento de fallos y desuscripción durante el dispatch.
